title: Visible fit proposals
scenario: I11 • Inspect a deterministic two-parameter fit in the live workspace.

slides.caption: Open the calibration sample
slides.expected: Gain 1 and offset 0 at revision 0. Apply is disabled.

slides.caption: Request a fit proposal
slides.expected: Inspect gain 1 to 3 and offset 0 to 4 alongside the unchanged live values.

slides.caption: Reject the proposal
slides.expected: The preview clears. Both values and the revision stay unchanged.

slides.caption: Request again and increase live gain
slides.action: Request again and increase live gain
slides.expected: Revision 1 has gain 2. The preview still describes revision 0.

slides.caption: Apply the outdated proposal
slides.expected: Stale rejection preserves gain 2 and offset 0 at revision 1.

slides.caption: Request a fresh proposal and apply it
slides.action: Request a fresh proposal and apply it
slides.expected: Both changes land together at revision 2. The preview clears.
